fichas.title: Laundry/utility rooms
fichas.summary: Laundry/utility rooms support washing, drying, ironing and sewing, and provide storage for household equipment and cleaning supplies. They are best placed near or accessible from the kitchen; detached houses should provide direct garden access for drying laundry. The layout should support comfortable appliance use, appropriate ironing-board heights, a washing worktop and uniform working-area lighting.
uses: Storing equipment, detergents, cleaning agents, polishes, buckets, vacuum cleaners, tools and ladders
